search_text: published ZDI-08-016 ZDI-CAN-285 Apple QuickTime MP4A Atom Parsing Heap Corruption Vulnerability 2008-04-03 CVE-2008-1018 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2008-1018 ['Apple'] ['Quicktime'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Apple QuickTime. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page. The specific flaw exists in the parsing of the QuickTime Channel Compositor atom. When the movie file contains a malformed 'chan' atom, a heap corruption occurs resulting in the execution of arbitrary code. Apple has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Apple QuickTime MP4A Atom Parsing Heap Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Apple QuickTime. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page. The specific flaw exists in the parsing of the QuickTime Channel Compositor atom. When the movie file contains a malformed 'chan' atom, a heap corruption occurs resulting in the execution of arbitrary code.
